# embtrace-sbom 0.9.1 — the default run ends in text, not a question

- **No question at the end of the default run** (TTY or not). It ends with
  three plain lines: `Wrote sbom.cdx.json (N components).`,
  `Nothing was transmitted.`, and the one command for the free report.
  Sending is a decision you make with `--send`; that path is unchanged
  (preview, privacy link, confirmation).
- **A second run updates your earlier embtrace-sbom output** instead of
  leaving `sbom.cdx-2.json` behind — and says so. A file of that name that
  was not written by this tool is never touched: the run stops with a
  hint to use `--sbom PATH`.
- The sentence "Your bill of materials is yours" is gone.
